en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural riverside village scene. A grassy bank and a small waterway or canal run along the left and foreground, with a simple bridge and railings crossing a sluice or weir. Several people stand or walk on the path by the water. In the background are clustered village houses, farm buildings, and leafless trees, with low hills and fields beyond. Printed red German text appears at the top left of the image area.
